def extract_answer(text):
    text = text.strip()
    m = re.match(r'^[(\[]?([A-Da-d])[)\].]?', text)

    m = re.search(r'(?:answer|correct)\s*(?:is|:)\s*[(\[]?([A-Da-d])', text, re.IGNORECASE)

    correct = 0

        response = tokenizer.decode(outputs[0][inputs["input_ids"].shape[1]:], skip_special_tokens=True)
